heading: *31 January 2026*
body:
*Gel runs for EcoRV assay*

Load samples 1-8 along with a TriDye 100 bp ladder. Run for 100 V, 90 mins → stain with SYBR green stain

Load samples on a 3% agarose gel:

1. Quick-load 100 bp ladder  
2. ELF2lig1  
3. ELF2lig4  
4. 1-8  
5. TriDye 100 bp

Run 110 V, 60 mins. Stain with SYBR Green.

*ELF ligand PCR repeat*

ELF\_sm\_EcoRV \= ELF lig3

ELFlig\_noEcoRV \= ELF lig2

5X PCR for each ligand:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ELFlig2/3 \- 10 ng/uL** | **10 uL** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **100 uL** |
| **ELF\_FWD 10 uM** | **10 uL** |
| **ELF\_REV2/REV3 10 uM** | **10 uL** |
| **Water** | **70 uL** |
| **Total** | **200 uL** |
